steps.description: Construct the numerical experiment to probe bootstrap solution space rigidity. Implement a small feedforward network training pipeline using scipy.optimize.minimize (L-BFGS-B) to find the minimum hidden layer width h that achieves zero violation (max abs error ≤ 1e-3 on held-out constraints) for varying constraint counts w. First establish a zero-violation anchor point (w_min, h_max), then scan h across [h_min, h_max] for each w with ≥3 random seeds. Report N_c(w) values, training/holdout errors, and trend classification (flat/decreasing/increasing). All code must use np.random.default_rng and return structured results via run(cfg).
